statement: ∀ n L : ℕ, ((Finset.Icc 1 L).filter (fun e => n = 2^e + 2^(Nat.log 2 (n-2^e)))).card ≤ 2

plain_statement.zh: 方法反例：每个目标至多两个移位落入二次幂例外集
plain_statement.en: Obstruction: at most two binary shifts hit a dyadic exceptional set at any target

brief.zh: 取二次幂为人工例外集。一个 n 至多有一种无序双幂分拆，因此最多两个坏指数；中心仍可属于无限例外集。说明即使几乎所有移位成功也不能自动移回中心。
brief.en: Use powers of two as synthetic exceptions. Binary expansion gives at most one unordered two-power decomposition, hence at most two bad exponents. Infinitely many centers remain exceptional.
